subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required) and bridge letter

Cc: jessica.morris@fincloud.com
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II request and gating NDA

Hi Stephanie,

We're conducting a vendor security assessment for our platform expansion and need a copy of Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covering the 2025 audit period (or the most recent period available). Our procurement policy requires a mutually executed NDA before we accept SOC reports. Can you share your standard mutual NDA or a DocuSign link so we can execute? Once executed, we'll need the redacted report and a bridge letter if the audit period does not fully cover our assessment window (we're looking at controls as of 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31).

In addition to the SOC report, we may request a completed SIG Lite or CAIQ later in the process. Please confirm timelines — we aim to wrap the initial security review in two weeks.

Thanks,
Jessica Morris
FinCloud — Security Operations
security@fincloud.com

Hi Jessica — thanks for the note and the timeline.

We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report after a mutually executed NDA. I've attached our standard mutual NDA (Redwood_Mutual_NDA_v1.pdf) and placed a DocuSign envelope if you prefer electronic signature: https://app.docusign.com/AAABBB-Redwood-NDA. Once we receive the executed NDA we will:
- Share a redacted PDF of the SOC 2 Type II report for the 2025 audit period
- Provide a short bridge letter if the report's audit period doesn't fully cover your requested window
- Scope the SIG/CAIQ follow-up and share an intake link for the questionnaire

A few clarifying Qs to speed this up:
1) Will FinCloud accept a redacted report (company name and auditor notes redacted) or do you require an unredacted copy under the NDA?
2) Do you need evidence of any specific control areas (e.g., logging/monitoring, encryption at rest, incident response)?

I'm looping in Aditya (security lead) for technical follow-ups, Marcus on compliance operations, and Laura from Legal to handle the NDA. Expect a turnaround of 48 business hours once the signed NDA is back.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Thanks Stephanie — we can accept a redacted copy under NDA. We'll countersign the mutual NDA.

A couple specifics so you can prepare:
- Primary scope: control environment and logging/monitoring controls for the hosted API
- Evidence needs: description of retention/configuration for audit logs, and a high-level statement on subservice auditor coverage (if any)
- If you can include the auditor name in the report metadata that helps our intake team.

I'll route the NDA through our legal e-signature flow and should have it back shortly (DocuSign). If possible, also include a one-paragraph bridge letter stating the audit period end date and whether there were any subsequent control changes through 2026-06-30.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
